raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner concluded Ekam was released first by relying on Farber's Nerve’s 2011 DVD/TV dates from IMDb, ignoring evidence (search snippet and Wikipedia) that the film’s earliest release was in 2006. They also failed to follow their own instruction to corroborate with Wikipedia/other sources and to use the earliest premiere date, comparing Ekam’s 2010 theatrical date to Farber’s 2011 home-media dates instead of its 2006 release.
